title: Board of County Commissioners
location: Ouray County 4-H Event Center, 22739 Highway 550, Ridgway, CO 81432
summary: The Ouray County BOCC meets October 27 at the 4-H Event Center in Ridgway. The board takes up a fifth extension of the Emergency Disaster Declaration — a marker of how long the county has been navigating that situation. General business includes two vacancy-fill requests under the austerity resolution (Clerk and Recorder's Office, Treasurer's Office), a response letter on the Si Se Puede trademark dispute with UFW, a road materials supply agreement, and a resolution supporting Proposition 137 on the November 3 ballot. The board also considers a proclamation naming October 28 Gold Mountain Fire First Responder Appreciation Day. Sitting as the Local Licensing Authority, commissioners review a liquor license renewal for Divide Ranch. Sitting as the Board of Adjustment, they hold a public hearing on a Land Use Code variance request from Martha Campbell and the Home Trust of Ouray County for a property on County Road 24D. Blair & Associates presents the 2025 audited financial report.

title: Town Council
location: Hybrid/Rebekah Hall, 113 W Columbia Ave
summary: Three substantive items anchor this meeting. Council takes up the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA, extending cost-sharing for the 2027 planning and development budget on the gondola replacement project — a line that connects directly to the SMART 3A funding voters approved. Two ordinances get first reading: one amending the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program (TEMP) under the municipal code, and one that would suspend the 5% capital fund allocation for open space in 2027 — a notable carve-out worth watching given the town's budget pressures. A work session covers special events on town property in 2026 and a proposed two-night concert in Town Park in August 2027. The long-running Stender Residence HARC appeal is continued again. Council also appoints an Open Space Commission member and approves routine minutes and a liquor licensing hearing officer.

title: Board of County Commissioners Work Session
location: Ouray County 4-H Event Center, 22739 Highway 550, Ridgway, CO 81432
summary: A work session, so no formal votes — but the main business is consequential: commissioners take up the proposed merger of EMS and Ridgway Fire, with a budget and operational discussion followed by a preliminary draft agreement for BOCC input. Merging emergency services is the kind of structural decision that shapes response times, staffing, and costs for years. Commissioner and administrative reports fill the earlier part of the afternoon.

title: Board of County Commissioners Work Session
location: Ouray County 4-H Event Center, 22739 Highway 550, Ridgway, CO 81432
summary: A work session — no formal votes — with two substantive conversations on the table. First, CDOT walks the commissioners through its annual planning presentation, covering what the state transportation agency has in store for the US-550 corridor and surrounding roads. Then the discussion shifts to FEMA Public Assistance, focusing on Ouray County's ongoing recovery projects and road damage assessments. Anyone who's watched mountain roads take a beating through wet cycles knows how long the repair queue can get — and how much of the funding story runs through federal reimbursement timelines.

It's a lot consolidation in the Historic Residential zone district, not a new development proposal.
